home.heroDescription: We design photorealistic 3D interiors and create custom furniture, combining digital precision with a passion for craftsmanship.
home.about: We combine digital design with physical craftsmanship. Our work is built on two complementary pillars that ensure consistency from the first sketch to the installation of the final handle.
home.designDescription: We turn your ideas into photorealistic images. With advanced 3D technology, you can see your future interior with every detail, material texture and play of light.
home.furnitureDescription: Your vision becomes reality. We specialize in delivering high-quality furniture made to order. Solid craftsmanship without compromise.
home.contactQuote: Whether you need a photorealistic design or perfectly crafted custom furniture, we are here to build it.

about.title: We define
about.intro: We are not interested in repetitive patterns. At Lilemar, we combine craftsmanship with 3D technology to create interiors that extend the personality of their owners.
about.description: We treat every project as a unique work of art. Our approach is based on three pillars: aesthetics, usability and the emotions a space evokes.
about.qualityDescription: Only materials and solutions we can stand behind completely.
about.energyDescription: We bring momentum and a fresh perspective to every square meter.
about.visionDescription: We see potential where others see only empty walls.
about.dialogDescription: Your voice is the foundation on which we build our concept.
about.ctaDescription: Let’s start with a conversation about your vision.

faq.question: How long does a visualization take?
faq.answer: A standard room up to 40 m2 takes 3-4 days. Larger spaces are discussed individually.

faq.question: How long does custom furniture take?
faq.answer: The design and estimate take up to one week. After approval, installation usually takes about four weeks.

faq.question: Which cities do you serve?
faq.answer: We deliver projects in Kuyavian-Pomeranian, Masovian, Łódź, Greater Poland, Pomeranian and Warmian-Masurian regions.

faq.question: How much does a visualization cost?
faq.answer: The price is set individually based on the project type, complexity and number of views.

faq.question: How much does custom furniture cost?
faq.answer: The price is set individually based on floor area, interior style and details.
